title: Rust: DAO refresh timer (30 min)
description: Implement DAO refresh timer. AC: DAO re-sent every 30 minutes while route valid.
notes: Implemented current authoritative spec/09 §14.2: 15-minute DAO refresh interval, exactly half the 30-minute soft-state lifetime. Added public no_std constants, checked deadline arithmetic, inactive/armed timer state, inclusive due semantics, remaining-time query, overflow-safe rescheduling, route-invalidation reset, and deterministic boundary/overflow tests. The bead's 30-minute wording came from an older draft and was intentionally not encoded. Green: cargo test -p lichen-rpl; cargo fmt -p lichen-rpl -- --check; cargo clippy -p lichen-rpl --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; cargo check -p lichen-rpl --no-default-features; git diff --check. No codereview run per batch-review phase.
close_reason: Implemented the authoritative 15-minute refresh (half of 30-minute soft-state lifetime), with checked deterministic no_std timer behavior and green Rust gates; stale 30-minute bead wording corrected by rationale.
